textureStaging.scope: Diagnostic private native-color-space textures on actual renderer context. ABAB invocation timings include state reset; explicit frame waits/readbacks, not whole-game or GPU benchmark. No texture replacement. Pixel conversion and every generated mip compared. Uses SRGB8_ALPHA8 for sRGB sources; reads encoded bytes and generated mipmaps, not shader screenshots. Bounded reference plus current readback; includes adversarial alpha fixture. Does not validate context loss, production memory lifecycle or scheduler throughput.
